milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The acacia logs are at (6,0-3,2) relative to spawn. max_distance=5 requires actual navigation since spawn-to-target distance is ~6.3 blocks. facing_tolerance=60 ensures player is looking at the tree.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce sapling is at (3,1,-7) relative to spawn (~7.6 blocks away). max_distance=4 requires the player to walk close to the sapling near the house entrance.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a wooden_shovel places it in the player's inventory. Player must harvest acacia_log, craft planks, then combine 1 plank + 2 sticks at the crafting table. The item is not in starting inventory so its presence confirms crafting.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a stone_hoe places it in the player's inventory. Player must mine cobblestone with the wooden_pickaxe and combine 2 cobblestone + 2 sticks at the crafting table. Not in starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting light_gray_stained_glass places it in inventory. Player combines 8 glass surrounding 1 light_gray_dye in the crafting table. Materials are given in starting inventory but the crafted product is not.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The decorative pillar of light_gray_stained_glass_pane is at (-3, 2, -6) relative to spawn (~6.7 blocks away). max_distance=4 requires close approach and facing confirms visual identification.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The dark_oak_fence_gate is at (1,1,-7) relative to spawn (~7.1 blocks away). max_distance=4 requires the player to walk up to the house entrance and face the gate.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because lighting up a house requires placing torch blocks inside the enclosed dark interior. The house interior is (-1,1,-11) to (3,2,-9) relative to spawn. Two rules check for floor-placed 'torch' OR wall-placed 'wall_torch' since players may place either type. Rule logic is OR — either rule being satisfied confirms the task is complete.

Uses inventory_has because mining red_nether_bricks with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The red nether brick structure is at (-8 to -6, 0-2, 6-8) relative to spawn. Player uses the provided wooden_pickaxe to break at least one block.

Uses inventory_has because killing a squid drops 1-3 ink_sac items into the player's inventory. The squid is in a water pool at (8-12, -1 to 0, 6-10) relative to spawn. Player uses the provided wooden_sword. ink_sac is not in starting inventory so its presence confirms a successful kill.
